title: Block 6: Implement a silent error-handling boundary to gracefully man
description: Implement a silent error-handling boundary to gracefully manage filesystem anomalies (e.g., missing `src/` directory). [Acceptance Criteria: If the source directory is missing or unreadable, the script catches the error silently, writes "0 .ts files" to the target output file, and exits without emitting any stack traces or warnings to standard output.]
